name: New Brunswick rent increase cap (3%)
description: Rent increases are capped at 3% for increases effective on or after 1 February 2025; the cap is maintained for 2027; six months' written notice; once per 12 months; landlords may apply for up to 9% for justified renovations.

attributes.above_cap: application to Tenant and Landlord Relations Office, up to 9% for capital expenditures
